content:
maria: FYI I noticed invoice-preview numbers are slightly higher for a handful of tenants after the route-estimate header rollout (proxy started sending X-Route-Estimate). not huge but consistent.

sam: saw the same in staging. previews up ~1.9% across medium-volume tenants. anyone tracing where estimate is flowing into billing?

lee: quick triage: the ingest enricher currently plumbs request headers into event.debug_meta for troubleshooting. X-Route-Estimate is landing there as estimate=0.0025 and some downstream transforms pull debug_meta.

oliver: so basically a debug header intended for routing heuristics leaked into price logic. oof. Is the transform reading debug_meta.price or is there a fallback chain?

maria: invoice-transform has: unit_price = explicit_price || metadata.price_override || plan_price. Because debug_meta ended up as metadata.price_override for some paths the preview used a higher override.

sam: two-pronged action: (A) stop copying all headers into metadata (tighten enricher), (B) make invoice-transform reject fields matching route_* or estimate_* unless tenant feature flag enabled.

lee: agree. I'll open a PR that introduces a header-safety whitelist and marks everything else as debug-only that doesn't propagate to pricing. Example config: 
```
HEADER_SAFELIST = ["X-Request-Id","X-Tenant-Id","X-Platform-Version"]
DEBUG_PREFIXES = ["X-Debug-","X-Test-"]
# X-Route-Estimate intentionally not in safelist
```
Will also add a short unit-test to assert headers not present in billing_event.metadata.

metering-bot: alert: invoice-preview-delta alert triggered: avg_preview_change=1.92% across sample tenants at 1768854350.

oliver: ops note: when we rollout the whitelist we should emit a metric header_leak.count with tag whitelisted=true/false so we can quantify the delta before/after. Also add transform reason tags so invoice pipeline emits why it picked a price (explicit/metadata/plan).

maria: product ask: can we show in console "preview rationale" when preview differs from last settled invoice? e.g., "Preview used metadata.price_override from event.debug_meta (not from billing config)" — helps reduce alerts.

sam: that's helpful. Minimal UI: badge on preview rows that expands to a tooltip with the mapping chain. We can wire that to the transform telemetry reason.

lee: small edge-case: some enterprise tenants actually want to bill by route and were depending on a debug header game we never documented. we'll need an explicit per-tenant opt-in (route_billing_enabled) that enables mapping route hints into invoicing. default must be false.

maria: agreed. implement opt-in gated at transform-level and ensure a contract/audit row is emitted whenever mapping happens so finance can reconcile.

oliver: rollout plan suggestion: 1) merge enricher safelist behind canary; 2) flip canary and monitor header_leak.count and invoice-preview-delta for 24h; 3) apply transform guard (default off) and run unit + integration tests; 4) expose console preview rationale; 5) open a finance review for tenants requesting route billing. rollback if preview delta increases >0.5% or error rate spikes.

sam: add automated alert that triggers when header_leak.count > threshold during canary so oncall is notified. Also include a smoke check that compares preview->settled for a sample tenant set after each step.

maria: I'll draft the PRs and include the additional telemetry metrics and the runbook steps (how to look at header_leak metric, how to flip route_billing_enabled, how to revert).

lee: local dev results: after applying safelist, header_leak.count dropped from ~4200/min to ~80/min (internal tests). Pushing canary later today.

metering-bot: metric: header_leak.count=4200 (pre-change) at 1768854300; header_leak.count=78 (post-local) at 1768854500.

maria: thanks. tagging @product and @finance for the opt-in policy. Let's avoid surprise billing behaviors.

sam: one more test: add E2E integration that simulates proxy sending different X-Route-Estimate values and asserts invoice_preview does not pick them up unless route_billing_enabled=true. prevents regression.

oliver: noted. I'll add the test and the transform telemetry tag (pricing_source=plan|explicit|metadata|optin_route).

maria: ok team, timeline: safelist PR today, canary tonight, transform guard in 48h, console copy next sprint. I'll follow up with the PR links here.

metering-bot: deploy note: enricher-canary pushed to staging at 1768854590.
